text:
```yaml
name: DB Migration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  db-migration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run migrations
      run: npm run migrate

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Check type definitions
      run: tsc --noEmit

    - name: Lint code
      run: npm run lint

    - name: Deploy to staging environment
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      env:
        DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        echo "Deploying to staging..."
        ./deploy.sh staging

    - name: Notify Slack about deployment
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      env:
        SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
      run: |
        echo "Notifying Slack about deployment..."
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data '{"text": "Deployment to staging completed successfully!"}' $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
```
